situations.headline: Thorney Opportunities (TOP) trading at ~33% discount to August NTA amid active buyback

changelog.entry: stage-2 assessment: Thorney Opportunities (TOP) trading at ~33% discount to August NTA amid active buyback (interest 5, risk 4)

thesis.text: TOP is a Thorney-managed small-cap LIC trading at a persistent discount (~33%) to after-tax NTA, with active on-market buyback support and a concentrated, actively-managed portfolio of ASX small/mid-caps; monitor monthly NTA trend, buyback pace, and portfolio concentration for discount-narrowing catalysts or capital return actions.
